study: Retrospective rat population adapter for NeuroTranslate 0.0
dataset: Shin and Jadhav, Single Day W-Track Learning, DANDI:000978/0.240511.0307, CC BY 4.0
known_before_design: The direct ridge and speed comparisons on these same three held rats were known. The frozen encoder has historical JS14 plus human right-wrist spatial training. JS14 and the two ZT2 assets are closed. No camera rows or neural events from these three test animals enter adapter fitting or selection. Single retrospective comparison, no retuning.
windows: Reuse all and only the qualified six packets and native candidate schedule, screening, targets, split, donor and weights in the source window protocol, in its exact order (824 train, 549 test). Take the first 16 eligible trips within each recorded epoch, donor only on first trip. Non-overlapping anchor times every 2s. Camera endpoint is the first frame at or after cutoff +0.25 s within 50 ms, target = native XY displacement in cm from the last observed frame. No future fields enter inference.
camera_inputs: Five most recent native headstage XY samples at or before cutoff + [-1,-.75,-.50,-.25,0] s, maximum age 75 ms. Per interval i derive the six inputs of the frozen distance encoder in this exact order: log1p(length_cm), (dt-.25)/.05, age_at_terminal_tap/.05, log1p(two_step_chord_cm), cosine_between_steps, log1p(.25*length_cm/dt). First interval's two-step chord and cosine zero. Report counts exceeding the old 50 ms/0.20–0.30 s temporal range. Use native values, without clipping; existing model domains retain their original validator.
neural_inputs: Four (left-open,right-closed) quarter-second bins on the native common clock from cutoff -1s through cutoff. Columns CA1 then PFC. For each region use log1p(count/(.25*file_local_registered_sorted_unit_count)). Train-time unit counts serve only as per-file denominators. No across-rat unit ID matching. No coordinate origin, orientation, cutoff time, rat or trip ID as a learned feature.
model: Freeze pretrained shared length-six projection, positional embedding, attention/feedforward weights and normalization. Compute all four 24-wide normalized token states using attention across observed history only. Motion features = four speed extrapolations (.25*length/dt) in chronological order then 24 final-token components. For each of the four tokens compute the scalar correction from that token's frozen rat spatial readout including bias. Combined features = motion features, then 8 log rates flattened time first, then the 8 chronological products of each rate with its corresponding token correction. Same conditional architecture with scrambled weights serves as one matched control. This is a temporal readout with a frozen encoder; neural measurements do not alter the attention weights.
fitting: Weighted squared error on raw centimetres, z scores (population-weighted mean/sd on training only, sd < 1e-8 replaced by 1); ridge lambda 0.03, intercept unpenalized; animal, eligible trip within animal, then retained window within trip equally weighted. Fit movement-only and combined once; prediction clipped at zero only after linear readout. Scoring uses fixed coefficients, no test calibration. All model and analysis arithmetic float64.
scrambled_control: Seed 20261120; NumPy default_rng permutation independently scrambles entries within each source tensor of spatial weights (sorted keys excluding all angular and new population arrays). Same shape, empirical marginal distribution, inputs, architecture, fitting and loss. One control realization; compare descriptive errors. Do not claim general representation superiority.
comparisons: same combined head with whole CA1/PFC bin matrix replaced by original same-animal completed-earlier-trip elapsed-time-matched donor
same fitted combined weights with chronological order of the four paired firing bins reversed at inference, a sensitivity test
same architecture and fitted heads on one scrambled encoder
previous published movement and combined and wrong-trip direct ridge and constant-speed predictions on the identical rows
scoring: Absolute error cm, mean within trip, mean across trips per animal, arithmetic mean of animals. Also report window-pooled MAE, all rats, trip scores, paired RMS prediction shift on donor and reversed-bin perturbations, number of rows changed (>1e-8 cm), and first chronological JS21 example including measured endpoint. Call consistent benefit only if firing beats matched motion AND donor on all three animals. Report whether it beats speed and direct ridge on each animal. No significance or causal or prospective between-study claim. A change in predictions alone verifies numerical dependence only.
legacy_acceptance: All pre-existing named numeric checkpoint arrays identical in shape/dtype/bytes. Existing config identical after removing the single new field. Compare spatial wrist and rat, wrist_angle motion/emg/full and forearm correction motion/emg via actual old/new executable APIs, including frozen published examples. Verify explicit rat_population mode, invalid input rejection, native-time validation, position-frame invariance, and rebuild from train-only inputs. No changes to existing domains on the basis of adapter scores.
